scope: One TP4 rank-local synthetic two-layer production host graph with CUDA callbacks; not loader, NCCL or full-model inference.
toolchain: Rust1.93.1 release, b200/kimi-k3/mxfp4, locked dependency resolution

payload_bytes.limits: excludes context, allocator overhead, small vectors, upload temporaries, wrapper scratch and KDA state; not measured RSS or GPU high-water

limitations: Sparse deterministic full-size matrices; not representative trained-weight performance.
Single local rank with no hidden all-reduce; no TP4 collective correctness claim.
Uses current host-KV MLA wrapper to match production graph, not unused resident helper.
